Pictures drawn by mathematics. Sperner's lemma colors the vertices of a triangulated triangle and finds a small triangle showing all three colors, built up here from barycentric coordinates to two very different classic proofs — one combinatorial, one geometric. Spirographs trace the path of a pen on one circle rolling around another, a curve whose whole shape is decided by the ratio of the two radii.
